Markets.title: HDFC Bank submits two candidates to RBI for next CEO
Markets.summary: HDFC Bank has submitted two candidates to the Reserve Bank of India for its next managing director and chief executive officer. Bloomberg News reported this information on Saturday based on an exchange filing.

Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Weak technical setup to keep bulls under pressure
Markets.summary: Dalal Street faces persistent selling pressure after the Nifty broke below its crucial 23,900-24,000 support zone, which is now expected to act as resistance. Furthermore, the index has fallen below both its 50-week and 100-week moving averages, signaling a technical deterioration in the market.

Markets.title: Explained: What Sebi’s proposed CAS changes mean for expiry-day trading and settlement
Markets.summary: SEBI has proposed two options for determining expiry-day settlement prices for index and stock derivatives. The regulator also suggested changes to trading session timings and additional measures to improve auction functions.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty has slipped below its crucial support, says Sudeep Shah; picks 5 stocks for next week
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices recovered from deeper intraday dips to end with modest declines as oil prices and bond yields eased. Analyst Sudeep Shah noted that the Nifty slipped below a crucial support level and recommended five stocks for the coming week.

Markets.title: Bitcoin trades at $77,000 mark as profit-taking weighs on market; September FOMC meeting to act as next catalyst
Markets.summary: Bitcoin traded near $77,000 following a slight retreat caused by profit-taking, while the global crypto market capitalization rose to $2.73 trillion. Investors are now closely watching the upcoming September FOMC meeting as the next major market catalyst.

Markets.title: Demat 2.0 explained: Why it matters for bond market investors
Markets.summary: SEBI launched a pilot scheme called Demat 2.0 to tokenize corporate bonds and enable faster settlement for investors. The initiative uses smart contracts to automate payments and minimize risks through seamless atomic settlements.

Geo-Political.summary: Saudi Arabia shut down a key oil pipeline following a drone attack launched from an area of Iraq bordering Iran. Iraq subsequently removed a military commander and opened an investigation into the incident.

Geo-Political.summary: French authorities are investigating whether a malicious act caused a passenger train derailment on Friday that injured 44 people. Investigators found a rail fragment on the tracks following the crash.

Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged BRICS nations to reduce trade barriers and strengthen business and investment partnerships. He also highlighted India's infrastructure, startups, and digital public infrastructure as drivers of global growth.

Data & Insights.title: Modi meets Pezeshkian amid US-Iran War: Seafarers’ safety in West Asia, BRICS cooperation discussed
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met during the 18th BRICS Summit on Friday. The two leaders discussed strengthening bilateral ties, multilateral cooperation, and the safety of seafarers in West Asia amidst ongoing conflict.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 7.8% Q1 GDP growth ‘above our expectations’, says IMF amid energy price shock
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF reported that India's economy grew by a better-than-expected 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. The organization praised India's improved data transparency, highlighting the country's continued role as a major global growth engine despite ongoing energy price shocks.

Data & Insights.title: In New Delhi, Putin pitches BRICS investment platform, says bloc’s growth outpaces G7 - ‘World is always changing’
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin pitched a new BRICS digital investment platform in New Delhi aimed at mobilizing private-sector funding and boosting economic competitiveness. He asserted that the bloc's economic growth is now outpacing that of the G7 nations.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: From trade to defence, energy and space - What transpired during Modi-Putin meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin met at the BRICS Summit to review bilateral cooperation. According to the Ministry of External Affairs, their discussions covered progress in political, economic, defence, energy, space, skills mobility, and people-to-people domains.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | Building BRICS In New Delhi
India.summary: As the host nation for the BRICS summit, India faces a key test of its modern foreign policy tenet known as strategic autonomy. This leadership role challenges India to balance its global partnerships while maintaining its independent stance on international affairs.

India.title: PM Modi Holds Hands With Xi, Putin In Powerful Message At BRICS Summit
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held hands with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in a powerful display of unity at the BRICS summit. The photographs from the event also featured Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Indonesian Prime Minister Prabowo Subianto.

India.title: Former Air India Pilot Found Dead At 5-Star Hotel In Delhi's Vasant Kunj
India.summary: A former Air India flight captain was found dead at Hotel The Grand in Delhi's Vasant Kunj area. Police reported that the man was discovered unconscious and unresponsive.

India.summary: A former Indian ambassador to China stated that the visual optics of Chinese President Xi Jinping visiting India for the BRICS summit are very important. He added that this bilateral meeting could pave the way for strong future outcomes.

India.summary: During the BRICS Summit 2026, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a 50-minute bilateral meeting to discuss trade and border issues. The summit highlights also noted the current member and partner countries of the BRICS bloc.

India.title: BRICS Targets Self-Reliance Through Energy, Food, Rare Earths
India.summary: BRICS countries are working to increase their economic self-reliance in response to global sanctions, tariffs, and trade restrictions. The bloc is focusing specifically on cooperation in energy, food, and rare earths to achieve this goal.

General.summary: Elena Rybakina defeated Aryna Sabalenka to win her first US Open title. The victory reinforces her status as the top women's tennis player in the world.
